translator_notes: 'Криво магаре' translated as 'lame donkey' (my reading; literally 'crooked donkey'). 'Ќе ме раскости' is rendered as 'will tear me apart' (my reading, roughly 'will pull my bones apart').

lines.en: Lenka set off for the mill,

lines.cyr: Па ми товари, мори, криво магаре,
lines.lat: Pa mi tovari, mori, krivo magare,
lines.en: And she loads, hey, a lame donkey,
a lame donkey, hey, a real she-donkey.
Uncle Yankula was waiting for her,

lines.cyr: - Постој невесто, мори, да ти помогнам,
lines.lat: - Postoj nevesto, mori, da ti pomognam,
lines.en: - Wait, bride, hey, let me help you,

lines.cyr: вреќи да кренам, мори, да растоварам.
lines.lat: vreḱi da krenam, mori, da rastovaram.
lines.en: to lift the sacks, hey, to unload them.

lines.cyr: Не ѝ ги кренал тешките вреќи,
lines.lat: Ne ì gi krenal teškite vreḱi,
lines.en: He did not lift the heavy sacks for her,

lines.cyr: тук' ми ја грабнал убава Ленка.
lines.lat: tuk' mi ja grabnal ubava Lenka.

lines.cyr: Ем ја постегнал, мори, ем ја поштипнал,
lines.lat: Em ja postegnal, mori, em ja poštipnal,
lines.en: He squeezed her, hey, and he pinched her,

lines.cyr: на бело лице, мори, белег направил.
lines.lat: na belo lice, mori, beleg napravil.
lines.en: on her white face, hey, he left a mark.

lines.cyr: како ќе одам жива до дома“?
lines.lat: kako ḱe odam živa do doma“?
lines.en: how will I get home alive?

lines.cyr: Белким мажот ми, мори, ќе ми опрости,
lines.lat: Belkim mažot mi, mori, ḱe mi oprosti,
lines.en: Perhaps my husband, hey, will forgive me,

lines.cyr: ама свекрва, леле, ќе ме раскости!
lines.lat: ama svekrva, lele, ḱe me raskosti!
lines.en: but my mother-in-law, oh dear, will tear me apart!'
